newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-RANGERS TRADE MORE TO COYOTES FOR EASTWOOD, MINOR LEAGUER.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-RANGERS TRADE MORE TO COYOTES FOR EASTWOOD, MINOR LEAGUER.

text.p: The New York Rangers traded defenceman Jayson More to the Phoenix Coyotes on Thursday for centre Mike Eastwood and minor league defenceman Dallas Eakins.
The 28-year-old More had a difficult time cracking the Rangers' regular rotation of defencemen this season. He appeared in just 14 games and had one assist and 25 penalty minutes.

The Rangers were seeking a physical centre to defend opposing centres such as Philadelphia's Eric Lindros and Pittsburgh's Mario Lemieux. Eastwood is known as a solid defensive forward with the ability to kill penalties and handle faceoffs.

In More, Phoenix hopes to add muscle on the backline. Other Coyotes' defencemen -- Oleg Tverdovsky, Teppo Numminen and Norm Maciver -- are mobile, finesse players who have had problems clearing the front of the net.
The 29-year-old Eastwood had just one goal and three assists in 33 games with the Coyotes this season. He set career-highs with 14 goals and 14 assists in 1995-96.
Eakins played primarily for Springfield of the American Hockey League this season.
